title: Slides show their Tasks and progress

steps.action: Open a slide naming a Task, then its slide-out.
steps.expected_result: The Task is listed with a link.

steps.action: Read the slide with its Task open and then done.
steps.expected_result: The slide says how many of its Tasks are done.

steps.action: Mark the Task done without touching the slide, and reload.
steps.expected_result: The slide now says 1 of 1 tasks done.

expected_result: Each step behaves as its acceptance criterion says.
